definition_zh: 外部性；外部效应；外在性
definition_en: an effect of an activity that falls on people who did not choose to bear it; also the quality of being outward or external
core_image: 工厂烟囱的烟越过围墙，落在邻居的晾衣绳上
scene: 这里指「外部性」。 The factory's pollution is a negative externality that the nearby residents pay for.
sceneCN: 这里 externality 是「外部性、外部成本」（第 1 个义项：成本落到交易之外的第三方）；句意：工厂的污染是一种负外部性，代价由附近居民承担。图中可辨识物件：烟囱、围墙、晾衣绳、口罩。

pos.zh: 外部性；外部效应；外在性

senses.title: Economics: a cost pushed onto others
senses.titleCN: 负外部性：成本落到旁观者身上
senses.definition: in economics, a cost of a transaction that is borne by people who are not part of it
senses.definitionCN: 经济学上指交易的成本由并未参与交易的人承担
senses.example: Air pollution from the plant is a negative externality for the whole valley.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂造成的空气污染对整个山谷来说是一种负外部性。
senses.why: The word names what stays 'external' to the price. The buyer and seller settle their account, and the cost that escapes the account lands on a third party.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是被留在价格“之外”的东西。买卖双方结清自己的账，逃出账本的成本落在第三方身上。

senses.title: Economics: a benefit given away
senses.titleCN: 正外部性：好处漏给了别人
senses.definition: in economics, a benefit of an activity that others receive without paying for it
senses.definitionCN: 经济学上指活动的收益被他人无偿获得
senses.example: Vaccination creates a positive externality by protecting people who were not vaccinated.
senses.exampleCN: 接种疫苗产生正外部性，保护了没有接种的人。
senses.why: The mechanism is the same as with costs, only the sign flips. Something crosses the boundary of the deal, and those outside gain instead of lose.
senses.whyCN: 机制与成本完全相同，只是符号翻转。有东西越过交易的边界，外面的人因此得利而非受损。

senses.title: The concept in policy
senses.titleCN: 外部效应：政策要处理的那部分
senses.definition: the general concept used in policy when private choices produce public consequences
senses.definitionCN: 政策讨论中使用的总称，指私人选择产生公共后果
senses.example: The report treats congestion as an externality that road pricing could correct.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把拥堵视为一种可通过道路定价纠正的外部效应。
senses.why: Once named, the externality becomes an object of policy. The word shifts from a description of harm to a thing that can be measured, taxed or regulated.
senses.whyCN: 一旦被命名，外部性就成了政策对象。这个词从“伤害的描述”变成可测量、可征税、可监管的“东西”。

senses.title: Network externality
senses.titleCN: 网络外部性：用的人越多越有价值
senses.definition: the effect by which a product becomes more useful to each user as the number of users grows
senses.definitionCN: 产品随着用户数量增加而对每个用户更有用的效应
senses.example: A messaging app shows a strong network externality: its value rises with every new user.
senses.exampleCN: 通讯应用表现出很强的网络外部性：每多一个用户，它的价值就上升。
senses.why: Here the external effect is between users rather than bystanders. Each new user benefits the others without intending to, which is the same 'outside the deal' logic.
senses.whyCN: 这里的外部效应发生在用户之间而非旁观者之间。每个新用户无意中让其他人受益，仍是“交易之外”的逻辑。

senses.title: Philosophy: outwardness
senses.definition: the quality of being outward or concerned only with external appearances
senses.definitionCN: 外在的性质，或只关注外部表象的状态
senses.example: The essay criticizes the externality of a life judged only by possessions.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章批评那种只以财物评判人生的外在性。
senses.why: This older sense is not economic at all: externality is the state of belonging to the outside. The economic sense is a specialized child of the same idea.
senses.whyCN: 这个较早的义项与经济无关：externality 是“属于外部”的状态。经济义只是同一观念的一个专门分支。

senses.title: External circumstances
senses.titleCN: 外部事物：身外的一切条件
senses.definition: things outside a person or system that affect it but are not part of it
senses.definitionCN: 位于个人或系统之外、会影响它却不属于它的事物
senses.example: The plan assumed stable prices and ignored externalities such as drought.
senses.exampleCN: 该计划假定价格稳定，忽略了干旱之类的外部因素。
senses.why: The plural here simply means outside conditions. What matters is the boundary: these things act on the system from beyond its edge.
senses.whyCN: 这里的复数只是“外部条件”。关键在于边界：这些事物从边界之外作用于系统。

senses.title: Internalizing them
senses.titleCN: 内部化：把外部成本收回账本
senses.definition: the process of making those outside costs part of the producer's own accounts, as through a tax
senses.definitionCN: 通过税收等手段让外部成本进入生产者自己账本的过程
senses.example: A carbon tax is a way of internalizing a climate externality.
senses.exampleCN: 碳税是把气候外部性内部化的一种方式。
senses.why: The phrase internalize an externality contains the whole story: something outside is brought inside the boundary of the accounts, where prices can see it.
senses.whyCN: internalize an externality 这个说法包含了整个故事：把外面的东西带进账本的边界，让价格看得见它。

senses.title: Spillover between neighbours
senses.titleCN: 邻里外溢：围墙挡不住的效应
senses.definition: any local side effect of one actor's activity on nearby people or property
senses.definitionCN: 某一行为者活动对附近的人或财产造成的任何局部副作用
senses.example: Noise from the late shift is a neighbourhood externality nobody priced.
senses.exampleCN: 夜班噪音是一种没人定过价的邻里外部性。
senses.why: The everyday version is the smoke over the fence. No economist is needed to see it: one person's activity leaves the property and lands on another's.
senses.whyCN: 日常版本就是越过围墙的烟。不需要经济学家也能看见：一个人的活动离开自己的地盘，落到别人的地盘上。

intro.en: Externality is external plus -ity. External comes from Latin externus 'outward', built on exter 'outside', which itself is a comparative form of ex 'out of'. The economic sense is a modern specialization.
intro.cn: externality 是 external 加 -ity。external 来自拉丁 externus“向外的”，建立在 exter“外面”之上，而 exter 又是 ex“出自”的比较级形式。经济义是现代专门化的结果。

items.en: ex meant 'out of, from'. It is the source of the English prefix ex- and of many prepositions in Romance languages.
items.cn: ex 意为“出自、从”。它是英语前缀 ex- 以及诸多罗曼语介词之源。

items.en: exter was an adjective meaning 'outward, on the outside', comparative in form. It described what lies beyond a boundary.
items.cn: exter 是形容词，意为“向外的、在外的”，形式上为比较级。它描述边界之外的东西。

items.en: externus 'outward, foreign' develops from exter. Latin also had exterus and the adverb foris 'out of doors' as parallel ways to say 'outside'.
items.cn: externus“向外的、外来的”由 exter 发展而来。拉丁语还有 exterus 以及副词 foris“在门外”，都是表达“外面”的并行方式。

items.en: English external appears in the 15th century through Late Latin externalis. It contrasts with internal, and the pair still organizes much academic vocabulary.
items.cn: 英语 external 于 15 世纪经晚期拉丁 externalis 进入。它与 internal 相对，这一对词至今组织着大量学术词汇。

items.en: The suffix -ity comes from Latin -itas and turns an adjective into a quality noun. Externality therefore means 'the quality of being external' before it means anything economic.
items.cn: 后缀 -ity 来自拉丁 -itas，把形容词变成性质名词。因此 externality 在获得经济含义之前，意思是“外在的性质”。

items.en: The economic use grows in the late 19th and 20th centuries, when economists needed a name for effects that escape the price of a transaction. The exact first use is disputed, so it is marked source uncertain.
items.cn: 经济用法在 19 世纪末至 20 世纪发展起来，经济学家需要一个名称来指逃出交易价格的影响。确切最早用例存有争议，故标“来源不确定”。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the exter- shape but includes one word from a completely different root; the near-meaning group all name effects that reach beyond the immediate parties.
note.cn: 形近组共享 exter- 外形，但其中一个是完全不同词根；近义组都指超出直接当事人之外的影响。

entries.definition: coming from or belonging to the outside. It is the base adjective; externality is the abstract noun built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 外部的；外来的。它是基础形容词，externality 是在其上构成的抽象名词。

entries.definition: in an outward way, or by an outside agent. It modifies an action, while externality names a thing or quality.
entries.definitionCN: 外部地；从外部。它修饰动作，而 externality 命名事物或性质。

entries.definition: the state of lasting forever. It sounds almost identical but comes from Latin aeternus 'eternal', not from exter 'outside'.
entries.definitionCN: 永恒性。它读音几乎相同，但来自拉丁 aeternus“永恒的”，并非 exter“外面”。

entries.definition: an effect that spreads from one area or group into another. It is the everyday image behind externality.
entries.definitionCN: 从一领域或群体扩散到另一领域的影响。它是 externality 背后的日常意象。

entries.definition: an unintended result of an action, usually unwanted. It is broader and need not involve a third party.
entries.definitionCN: 行为的非预期结果，通常不受欢迎。它范围更广，不必涉及第三方。

entries.definition: something produced as a secondary result. It points to the output itself, while externality points to who bears it.
entries.definitionCN: 次要产物。它指向产出物本身，而 externality 指向由谁承担。

entries.definition: an effect on someone who is not one of the parties involved. It is the plain-language definition of an externality.
entries.definitionCN: 对非当事人产生的影响。它就是 externality 的白话定义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: exter means 'outside': an externality is what sits outside the deal and still sends its bill in.
normal.cn: exter 意为“外面”：externality 就是坐在交易之外、却把账单寄进来的东西。

normal.en: external, externally and externality form a clean family of adjective, adverb and noun.
normal.cn: external、externally、externality 构成形容词、副词、名词的整齐一族。

normal.en: negative externality and positive externality differ only in sign, not in mechanism.
normal.cn: negative externality 与 positive externality 只在符号上不同，机制相同。

normal.en: internalize an externality is the useful phrase: the outside cost is brought inside the accounts.
normal.cn: internalize an externality 是有用的搭配：把外部成本带进账本内部。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with eternality: eternity is forever, externality is outside.
normal.cn: 别与 eternality 混淆：eternity 是永远，externality 是外面。

abstract.en: Think of smoke crossing a fence and settling on someone else's washing.
abstract.cn: 想象烟越过围墙，落在别人晾着的衣服上。

abstract.en: Think of a factory's bill being quietly forwarded to a house it has never visited.
abstract.cn: 想象工厂的账单被悄悄转寄到一栋它从未去过的房子。

abstract.en: Think of a boundary line drawn around a deal, with arrows leaking out of it in both directions.
abstract.cn: 想象在交易周围画一条边界线，箭头从线的两侧漏出去。

examples.en: Economists argue that a tax on carbon would price the externality into every decision.
examples.cn: 经济学家认为，碳税会把外部性计入每一个决策。

examples.en: The new rail link produced a positive externality for firms along the route.
examples.cn: 新铁路为沿线的企业带来了正外部性。

examples.en: Noise and traffic are the two externalities residents mention most often.
examples.cn: 噪音与交通是居民最常提到的两项外部性。

dict_mnemonic.text: “外部哪里提”——成本不在内部账上，要问“外部哪里提（ti）走”→ externality 外部性

root: 拉丁 exter“外面”（ex“出自”的比较级形式）→ externus“向外的” → 英语 external + -ity；经济义为 19 世纪末以来的专门化用法。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one boundary: something crosses the edge of a transaction or a system and lands on someone who did not ask for it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一条边界：某物越过交易或系统的边缘，落到并未要求它的人身上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: smoke crossing a fence onto a neighbour's washing.
core.cn: 核心意象：烟越过围墙，落到邻居晾着的衣服上。

branches.en: THE SIGN: negative and positive externalities are one crossing, differing only in whether the outsider gains or loses.
branches.cn: 符号：负与正外部性是同一次越界，区别只在外人受损还是受益。

branches.en: POLICY: naming an externality turns it into something that can be taxed, and internalizing brings it back inside the accounts.
branches.cn: 政策：命名外部性使它变成可征税之物，内部化则把它带回账本。

branches.en: NETWORK: users benefit one another unintentionally, the same outside-the-deal logic applied between users.
branches.cn: 网络：用户无意中相互受益，同一套“交易之外”的逻辑用在用户之间。

branches.en: OUTWARDNESS: the older senses name the state of being outside, before economics specialized the word.
branches.cn: 外在性：较早的义项命名“处于外部”的状态，早于经济学的专门化。

branches.en: NEIGHBOURS: the everyday local effect is the plainest picture of the whole concept.
branches.cn: 邻里：日常的局部影响是整个概念最朴素的画面。

intro.en: Externality is external plus -ity. The -ity suffix turns the adjective into a quality noun, while the base keeps the Latin comparative exter 'more outside'.
intro.cn: externality 是 external 加 -ity。-ity 把形容词变成性质名词，词基保留了拉丁比较级 exter“更外面”。

latinIntro.en: The family runs from ex 'out of' to exter 'outside' to externus 'outward'. English builds external, externally and externality on the last form.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族从 ex“出自”到 exter“外面”再到 externus“向外的”。英语在最后一形上构成 external、externally、externality。

items.meaningCN: 外部的；外来的（-al 关系形容词）
items.example: The review brought in two external experts.
items.exampleCN: 评审引入了两位外部专家。

items.meaningCN: 从外部；外部地（-ly 方式副词）
items.example: The tank is externally reinforced with steel bars.
items.exampleCN: 罐体外部用钢条加固。

items.meaning: the quality of being external; an outside effect
items.meaningCN: 外在性；外部性（-ity 性质名词）
items.example: The externality is borne by the fishing village.
items.exampleCN: 这项外部性由渔村承担。

items.meaning: to make outward or attribute to outside causes
items.meaningCN: 使外化；归因于外部（-ize 使动动词）
items.example: He externalized the blame onto the weather.
items.exampleCN: 他把责任外化到天气上。

items.meaning: the process of making something external
items.meaningCN: 外化过程（-ation 过程名词）
items.example: Externalization of costs is the core of the problem.
items.exampleCN: 成本的外化正是问题的核心。

items.meaning: a view that stresses outside conditions
items.meaningCN: 外在主义（-ism 体系名词）
items.example: Externalism holds that meaning depends on the world outside the mind.
items.exampleCN: 外在主义认为意义取决于心灵之外的世界。

items.meaning: an external student or worker, now rare
items.example: The hospital took on two externs from the university.
items.exampleCN: 医院接收了两名大学的走读实习生。

items.meaningCN: 外部；外表（exter 的比较级形式）
items.example: The exterior of the building was painted last year.
items.exampleCN: 这栋楼的外表去年刷过漆。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 与外部有关的（晚期拉丁）

definition_zh: 从外部；外部地；外表上；表面上
definition_en: in a way that comes from, happens on, or relates to the outside of something
core_image: 一栋楼的外墙：里面看不见，外面一眼就看得清
scene: 这栋老仓库的外墙刚刷过漆，路过的人以为它整修过了，其实里面还空着。Externally the warehouse looks freshly painted, though the inside is still empty.
sceneCN: 这里 externally 是「外表上」（第 3 个义项：只就外观而言）；句意：从外面看，这座仓库像刚刷过漆，里面却仍然空着。

pos.zh: 从外部；外部地；外表上；表面上

derivatives.zh: 基础形容词，义为「外部的；外来的」
加 -ity 构成，义为「外部性；外在影响」
加 -ize 构成，义为「使外化；把……表露于外」

senses.title: From the outside
senses.definition: in a way that acts on or comes from the outside of a thing rather than from within it
senses.definitionCN: 作用于或来自某物外部，而不是来自其内部
senses.example: The pressure was applied externally to the sealed tank.
senses.exampleCN: 压力是从外部施加到这个密封罐上的。
senses.why: Latin externus means outward, so the adverb first marks whatever acts from beyond the surface.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 externus 意为「向外的」，所以这个副词首先标记从表面之外起作用的事物。

senses.title: On the surface of the body
senses.definition: in a way that is put on the skin or another surface of the body rather than swallowed
senses.definitionCN: 涂敷在皮肤或身体表面，而不是吞服
senses.example: This ointment is to be used externally, never swallowed.
senses.exampleCN: 这瓶药膏只供外用，绝不可吞服。
senses.why: Medicine keeps the oldest spatial meaning: the remedy stays outside the body and works on its surface.
senses.whyCN: 医学保留了最古老的空间义：药物留在身体之外，只在表面起作用。

senses.title: In outward appearance
senses.definition: as judged by the outer appearance of something, not by what is hidden inside
senses.definitionCN: 按某物的外观来判断，而不是看内部藏着什么
senses.example: Externally the car looks new, but the engine is worn out.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车外表崭新，发动机却已经磨损。
senses.why: If the adverb marks the outside, it naturally comes to name the surface that other people can see.
senses.whyCN: 既然副词标记的是外面，它自然引申为别人能看到的那层表面。

senses.title: By outside funding
senses.definition: by money, goods, or support coming from outside an organization
senses.definitionCN: 资金、物资或支持来自组织之外
senses.example: The research unit is externally funded by a private trust.
senses.exampleCN: 这个研究组由一家私人基金会从外部提供资金。
senses.why: An organization also has an outside, so money that crosses its boundary is said to arrive externally.
senses.whyCN: 组织同样有「外面」，越过边界进来的钱就被说成来自外部。

senses.title: By hiring from outside
senses.definition: by appointing someone who did not already work inside the organization
senses.definitionCN: 任命原本不在该组织内部工作的人
senses.example: The new finance director was recruited externally.
senses.exampleCN: 新的财务总监是从外部招聘的。
senses.why: A post filled from beyond the walls is filled externally, the same boundary image as funding.
senses.whyCN: 职位由墙外的人填上，就是「从外部」填补，与资金同一边界意象。

senses.title: On the surface of behaviour
senses.definition: as far as other people can see, whatever the hidden feelings may be
senses.definitionCN: 就别人能看见的部分而言，不管隐藏的感受如何
senses.example: She remained externally calm while the interview went badly.
senses.exampleCN: 面试进行得很糟，她表面上却保持镇定。
senses.why: Feelings are hidden inside a person, so the face that others read is the external side of that person.
senses.whyCN: 情绪藏在人的内部，别人读到的那张脸就是这个人「外部」的一面。

senses.title: On an outside mount
senses.definition: by being fixed to the outside of a machine or a building rather than built into it
senses.definitionCN: 固定在机器或建筑的外部，而不是装在内部
senses.example: The camera is mounted externally on the wing of the drone.
senses.exampleCN: 相机外挂在无人机的机翼上。
senses.why: Hardware copies the spatial sense literally: the part sits on the shell, not within it.
senses.whyCN: 硬件把这个空间义照字面来用：零件待在外壳上，而不是里面。

senses.title: By access from outside
senses.definition: in a way that can be reached or used from outside a system or a network
senses.definitionCN: 能够从系统或网络之外连上或使用
senses.example: The backup drive is externally accessible through a single cable.
senses.exampleCN: 这个备份硬盘通过一根线缆就能从外部访问。
senses.why: A network has an inside and an outside, and a door on the shell is the adverb in its modern technical dress.
senses.whyCN: 网络有内部与外部，在外壳上开一扇门，正是这个副词在现代技术里的样子。

intro.en: Externally is the English adjective external plus -ly; external comes from Latin externus, outward or foreign.
intro.cn: externally 是英语形容词 external 加 -ly；external 来自拉丁语 externus，意为向外的、外来的。

items.en: The preposition ex means out of or from within.
items.cn: 介词 ex 意为「出自、从里面出来」。

items.en: Exterus, an old comparative form, means outward or outer.
items.cn: exterus 是古老的比较级形式，意为外面的、外部的。

items.en: Externus adds a suffix to exterus and means outward or foreign.
items.cn: externus 在 exterus 上加词尾，意为外部的、外来的。

items.en: English borrows external from Latin, chiefly in learned writing.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语借入 external，多见于学术文字。

items.en: The suffix -ly turns external into the adverb externally.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 把 external 变成副词 externally。

items.en: Modern use spreads from position and appearance to funding, hiring, and hardware.
items.cn: 现代用法从位置与外观扩展到资金、招聘与硬件。

note.en: Externally is the adverb of external, close to exterior and externality, and beside outwardly and superficially.
note.cn: externally 是 external 的副词，与 exterior、externality 同族，也与 outwardly、superficially 这类词相邻。

entries.definition: on or coming from the outside
entries.definitionCN: 外部的；来自外部的，是 externally 的形容词原形

entries.definition: the outer surface of something, or its outside
entries.definitionCN: 外部；外表，与 external 同出拉丁语比较级词形

entries.definition: an outside effect, especially an economic one
entries.definitionCN: 外部性；外在影响，由 external 加 -ity 构成

entries.definition: as shown on the outside, especially of feelings
entries.definitionCN: 表面上；外表上，多指情绪的外显

entries.definition: in a way that concerns only the surface
entries.definitionCN: 表面上；浅层地，强调只涉及表面

entries.definition: on or to the exterior of something
entries.definitionCN: 在外面；向外面，是更日常的说法

normalIntro.en: Externally is external plus -ly, and external carries the Latin sense of outward: whatever stands on the outer side is done externally.
normalIntro.cn: externally 是 external 加 -ly，而 external 带着拉丁语「向外」的意思：凡是待在外侧的事，都是从外部发生的。

normal.en: External plus -ly gives externally, meaning in an outside way.
normal.cn: external 加 -ly 就是 externally，意思是「以外部的方式」。

normal.en: Money that is externally funded comes from beyond the organization.
normal.cn: 由外部提供资金的款项，来自组织之外。

normal.en: A medicine used externally stays on the skin and is never swallowed.
normal.cn: 外用的药留在皮肤上，绝不吞服。

normal.en: Externally mounted parts sit on the shell instead of inside the case.
normal.cn: 外挂安装的零件待在外壳上，而不是机箱里面。

normal.en: Compare externally with outwardly: outwardly often describes behaviour, externally often describes origin or position.
normal.cn: 对比 outwardly：outwardly 多描述举止，externally 多描述来源或位置。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressing flat on the outside of a closed glass jar.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手平贴在密封玻璃罐的外壁上往里按。

abstract.en: Imagine ointment spread across the skin, with the tube marked for outside use only.
abstract.cn: 想象药膏涂在皮肤上，药管上标着只供外用。

abstract.en: Think of a house whose paint is fresh while the rooms inside stand empty.
abstract.cn: 想象一栋房子外墙油漆崭新，里面的房间却空着。

examples.en: The project is externally funded, so the budget must be approved by the trust.
examples.cn: 这个项目由外部提供资金，因此预算必须经基金会批准。

examples.en: The old mill looks externally intact, but the roof has fallen in.
examples.cn: 这座老磨坊外表看来完好，屋顶却已经塌了。

examples.en: The sensor is mounted externally and can be swapped without opening the case.
examples.cn: 传感器外挂安装，不用打开机箱就能更换。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊克斯特诺里」——谐音近似「一颗丝在外头」：丝线露在外头，就是「从外部、外表上」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex（向外）→ exterus（外面的）→ externus（外部的、外来的）→ 英语 external → 加 -ly 得 externally，核心义「在或来自外面」。

sensesIntro.en: Externally begins with a force acting on a surface, passes to medicine applied on the skin, then to outward appearance, to money and people brought in from outside, and finally to visible behaviour, hardware fixed outside, and outside access.
sensesIntro.cn: externally 先从作用于表面的力开始，转到涂在皮肤上的药，再到外观，接着是由外而来的资金与人，最后落到可见的举止、外挂的硬件与从外部接入。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the outer wall of a building, the side that others see first.
core.cn: 核心意象：一栋楼的外墙，别人最先看到的那一面。

branches.en: A force acting from beyond the surface is the literal spatial sense.
branches.cn: 从表面之外施加的力，是最字面的空间义项。

branches.en: A remedy kept on the skin is the medical sense.
branches.cn: 留在皮肤上的药物，是医学层面的义项。

branches.en: Outer appearance is the sense that judges by looks alone.
branches.cn: 只看外观来评判，是外表层面的义项。

branches.en: Funding and hiring both cross the boundary of an organization.
branches.cn: 资金与招聘都越过了组织的边界。

branches.en: Behaviour, hardware, and networks each have an inside that others see or reach from without.
branches.cn: 举止、硬件与网络各有一个内部，别人从外面看得见或够得着。

intro.en: Externally is Latin externus plus the English suffix -ly; external, exterior, and externality all share the same outside image.
intro.cn: externally 是拉丁语 externus 加英语词尾 -ly；external、exterior 与 externality 共享同一个「外面」的意象。

latinIntro.en: Latin ex means out of, and externus means outward or foreign.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ex 意为「出自」，externus 意为向外的、外来的。

items.example: The prefix ex- points from the inside toward the outside.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 把方向从里面指向外面。

items.example: Exterus is the old outer form behind external.
items.exampleCN: exterus 是 external 背后那个古老的「外面」词形。

items.example: Externus is the direct source of external.
items.exampleCN: externus 是 external 的直接来源。

items.example: External damage shows on the shell of the machine.
items.exampleCN: 外部损伤显示在机器的外壳上。

items.example: The suffix -ly turns adjectives into adverbs of manner.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 把形容词变成方式副词。

items.example: Externally describes how something is seen or done from outside.
items.exampleCN: externally 描述某事从外部被看到或被做成的方式。

items.example: Exterior keeps the comparative shape of the Latin word.
items.exampleCN: exterior 保留了那个拉丁词形的比较级痕迹。

items.example: Externality names a cost that falls on outsiders.
items.exampleCN: externality 指落在局外人身上的成本。

items.example: Externalize means to turn an inner state outward.
items.exampleCN: externalize 意为把内在状态转到外面。

definition_zh: 灭绝的；绝种的；（火山）熄灭的；（语言、习俗）已消亡的
definition_en: no longer existing as a living species, or no longer active, spoken or in use
core_image: 一座火山口安静地积着雨水，山坡长满树，看不出这里曾经喷发
scene: 这里指「灭绝的」。 The volcano has been extinct for ten thousand years, its crater now a lake.
sceneCN: 这里 extinct 指「火山已停止活动、不会再喷发」（第 2 个义项：火山进入休眠终止状态）；句意为这座火山已熄灭一万年，火山口如今成了湖。图中可辨识物件：积水火山口、覆满植被的山坡、岩层剖面、远处无烟的天际。

pos.zh: 灭绝的；绝种的；（火山）熄灭的；（语言、习俗）已消亡的

forms.label: 现在分词作定语（正在消失的）

senses.title: No longer living as a species
senses.definition: no longer existing as a living species anywhere on earth
senses.definitionCN: 地球上不再有任何活着的个体
senses.example: The passenger pigeon is extinct, though its skins fill museum drawers.
senses.exampleCN: 旅鸽已经灭绝，尽管它的皮毛还塞满博物馆的抽屉。
senses.why: extinct is the past participle of a verb meaning to put out, so a species described this way is one whose flame has gone out.
senses.whyCN: extinct 是「弄灭」这个动词的过去分词，因此被这样描述的物种，就是火已熄灭的那一个。

senses.title: A volcano that will not erupt again
senses.titleCN: 死火山：不再活动的火山
senses.definition: no longer capable of erupting, said of a volcano whose magma supply is cut off
senses.definitionCN: 指火山不再喷发，岩浆供给已切断
senses.example: The volcano has been extinct for ten thousand years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座火山已熄灭一万年。
senses.why: the image of a quenched fire fits a volcano exactly: the fire is out and the mountain is only a shape.
senses.whyCN: 「火被弄灭」的意象正合火山：火已熄，山只剩下一个形状。

senses.title: A language with no native speakers
senses.definition: no longer spoken as a mother tongue by any community
senses.definitionCN: 不再有任何社群把它当作母语使用
senses.example: The language went extinct when its last fluent speaker died in 1987.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一位流利使用者于 1987 年离世后，这门语言就消亡了。
senses.why: a language is kept alive by its speakers, so when the last one goes the word for a quenched flame applies.
senses.whyCN: 语言靠使用者维持生命，最后一人离去，便可以用「火已熄灭」来形容。

senses.title: A family line that has died out
senses.definition: having no living descendants, said of a family or lineage
senses.definitionCN: 指家族或世系已无在世后代
senses.example: The male line became extinct in the fifteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 这一支男系在 15 世纪断绝。
senses.why: Latin used the verb of a family whose last member died, and English kept that figurative use intact.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语就用这个动词指家族最后一人死去，英语完整保留了这一比喻用法。

senses.title: A fire or light put out
senses.definition: no longer burning or shining, used in literary and older prose
senses.definitionCN: 不再燃烧或发光，用于文学与较早的书面语
senses.example: By midnight every lamp in the hall was extinct.
senses.exampleCN: 到午夜，大厅里每一盏灯都熄了。
senses.why: this is the literal sense from which all the others were cut, and it survives in elevated writing.
senses.whyCN: 这是所有其他义项所由切出的字面义，仍存活于较庄重的文字中。

senses.title: A custom no longer practised
senses.definition: no longer existing in practice, said of a custom, craft or usage
senses.definitionCN: 指习俗、手艺或用法已不再实际存在
senses.example: The craft of hand-setting type is nearly extinct.
senses.exampleCN: 手工排字这门手艺已近乎消亡。
senses.why: a practice lives only while people perform it, so it goes out like a flame when the last practitioners stop.
senses.whyCN: 一种做法只在人们实践时存在，最后一批人停手，它便像火一样熄灭。

senses.title: A right no longer in force
senses.definition: no longer legally valid, said of a right, claim or obligation
senses.definitionCN: 指权利、主张或义务在法律上已失效
senses.example: The easement is extinct once the dominant estate is sold.
senses.exampleCN: 需役地被出售后，这项地役权即归消灭。
senses.why: law borrows the word for anything that has ceased to exist in law, keeping the sense of being put out.
senses.whyCN: 法律借这个词指在法律上不复存在之物，保留「被弄灭」的意思。

senses.title: Gone from the wild, kept in captivity
senses.titleCN: 野外灭绝：仅存于人工饲养
senses.definition: no longer surviving in the wild but still kept in zoos or collections
senses.definitionCN: 野外已无存活个体，但动物园或收藏机构仍有饲养
senses.example: The antelope is extinct in the wild but breeds in captivity.
senses.exampleCN: 这种羚羊在野外已灭绝，但在人工饲养下仍能繁殖。
senses.why: conservation needed a label in between living and lost, and the fixed phrase extinct in the wild supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 保护工作需要「既未全活也未全失」的状态标签，固定说法「野外灭绝」正好补上这个位置。

intro.en: Extinct is the past participle of Latin exstinguere 'to put out, quench', used in English as an adjective from the sixteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: extinct 是拉丁 exstinguere「熄灭、扑灭」的过去分词，自 16 世纪起在英语中作形容词使用。年代均为约数。

items.en: Exstinguere combined ex- 'out' with stinguere 'to prick, quench'; its past participle exstinctus meant 'put out, quenched'.
items.cn: exstinguere 把 ex-「向外」与 stinguere「刺、熄灭」结合，其过去分词 exstinctus 意为「已熄灭的」。

items.en: English adopted exstinctus as extinct in the sixteenth century, first of fires, lights and family lines.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪把 exstinctus 吸收为 extinct，最初用于火、光与家族世系。

items.en: The geological use for a volcano that will not erupt again is recorded from the seventeenth century, as naturalists classified mountains as active or quiet.
items.cn: 指不会再喷发的火山这一地质用法在 17 世纪有记录，当时博物学家把山分为活动与安静两类。

items.en: The sense of a species having died out spread in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries with the fossil record and with Cuvier's work on vanished animals.
items.cn: 物种已灭绝的意思在 18 至 19 世纪随化石记录与居维叶对消失动物的研究而扩散。

items.en: The fixed phrase extinct in the wild was adopted in the twentieth century to mark species surviving only in captivity.
items.cn: 固定说法「野外灭绝」于 20 世纪被采用，用来标记仅存于人工饲养的物种。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): early citations for the volcano and species senses are not precisely fixed, and the pre-Latin origin of stinguere remains unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：火山义与物种义的最早书证没有精确定论；stinguere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论。

note.en: Group one holds words of the same stinguere stock that look almost identical; group two holds adjectives for things no longer present.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 stinguere 词干、外形几乎相同的词；第二组表示「已不存在」的形容词。

entries.definition: The event or process of dying out; extinct describes the resulting state.
entries.definitionCN: 指灭绝的事件或过程；extinct 描述由此形成的状态。

entries.definition: To put out a fire or wipe out something; extinct is what remains after the act.
entries.definitionCN: 扑灭火或抹去某物；extinct 是行为之后留下的状态。

entries.definition: Dis- 'apart' plus stinguere: marked off, hence clear and separate. It has no trace of dying out.
entries.definitionCN: dis-「分开」加 stinguere：被划分开，因此指清楚、分明。毫无「消亡」之意。

entries.definition: In- 'in' plus stinguere, 'pricked from within': the word names an inborn impulse, not an ending.
entries.definitionCN: in-「在内」加 stinguere，「被内在刺动」：指天生冲动，不指终结。

entries.definition: Gone from view or existence, often used loosely; a vanished custom may return, an extinct species cannot.
entries.definitionCN: 指从视野或存在中消失，用法较宽；消失的习俗可能回来，灭绝的物种不能。

entries.definition: Said of organizations, laws or machines that have stopped working; it is not used of species.
entries.definitionCN: 用于停止运作的机构、法律或机器；不用于物种。

entries.definition: Inactive but able to revive, as a dormant volcano or seed; extinct means there is no revival.
entries.definitionCN: 指暂不活动但仍可能复活，如休眠火山或种子；extinct 指再无复活可能。

entries.definition: No longer used because something better replaced it, said of words or tools; it implies replacement, not death.
entries.definitionCN: 因被更好的东西取代而不再使用，用于词或工具；含「被取代」而非「死亡」之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ex- 'out' + stinguere 'quench': the flame has been put out.
normal.cn: ex-「向外」+ stinguere「熄灭」：火已被弄灭。

normal.en: The family runs extinct, extinction, extinguish, extinguisher, extinctive.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 extinct、extinction、extinguish、extinguisher、extinctive。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: extinct species, extinct volcano, extinct language, extinct in the wild.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：已灭绝物种、死火山、消亡语言、野外灭绝。

normal.en: It is an absolute adjective, so grammar prefers go extinct to more extinct.
normal.cn: 它是绝对形容词，因此语法上更常说 go extinct 而不是 more extinct。

normal.en: The same root appears in distinct and instinct with different prefixes.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 distinct 与 instinct 中，前缀不同。

abstract.en: Picture a crater full of rainwater where fire used to be.
abstract.cn: 想象一个积满雨水的火山口，那里曾经是火。

abstract.en: Picture a museum drawer of skins that are the last of their kind.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆抽屉里的皮毛，是它们那类最后的遗存。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp with no oil left, however polished the brass.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏没有油可点的灯，黄铜再亮也无用。

examples.en: The species was declared extinct after three years without a sighting.
examples.cn: 连续三年没有观测记录后，该物种被宣布灭绝。

examples.en: An extinct volcano can still host hot springs.
examples.cn: 死火山仍可能有温泉。

examples.en: The dialect is not extinct yet, but no children speak it.
examples.cn: 这种方言尚未消亡，但已没有孩子会说。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）+ tinct（熄灭）」——火灭得干干净净 → 灭绝的、熄灭的

root: 拉丁 exstinctus（exstinguere「熄灭」的过去分词）= ex-「向外」+ stinguere「刺、熄灭」；英语 extinct。与 extinction、extinguish 同族，与 distinct、instinct 同根不同前缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one state: a fire is out, and that outness is then read as a species, a volcano, a language, a lineage, a lamp, a craft, a legal right and a species that survives only in cages.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个状态展开：火已灭，这个「灭」再被读成物种、火山、语言、世系、灯、手艺、法律权利，以及只活在笼中的物种。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crater holding rainwater where fire once was.
core.cn: 核心意象：火山口积着雨水，那里曾经是火。

branches.en: LIVING LINE ENDED: species and family lines both reach a last member.
branches.cn: 活的世系终止：物种与家族都走到最后一位成员。

branches.en: MOUNTAIN QUIET: a quenched fire explains an unerupting volcano.
branches.cn: 山的安静：熄灭的火解释了不再喷发的火山。

branches.en: CARRIERS SILENT: a language and a craft last only while someone performs them.
branches.cn: 承载者沉默：语言与手艺只在有人实践时存在。

branches.en: LITERAL LAMP: the oldest sense, kept for elevated prose.
branches.cn: 字面的灯：最古老的义项，保留在庄重文字里。

branches.en: LEGAL AND CAPTIVE ENDS: a right can be extinguished, and a species can be extinct in the wild only.
branches.cn: 法律与圈养两端：权利可被消灭，物种也可只在野外灭绝。

intro.en: Extinct is a Latin participle used as an adjective; ex- supplies 'out' and stinguere supplies the quenching, both visible across its word family.
intro.cn: extinct 是作形容词用的拉丁分词；ex- 提供「向外」，stinguere 提供「熄灭」，两者在整个词族中都看得见。

latinIntro.en: Exstinguere yields extinct, extinction and extinguish; the same root with other prefixes yields distinct, instinct and distinguish.
latinIntro.cn: exstinguere 衍生 extinct、extinction 与 extinguish；同一词根换前缀则得 distinct、instinct 与 distinguish。

items.exampleCN: 前缀标记火被驱出。

items.example: The root carries the quenching image.
items.exampleCN: 词根带着熄灭的意象。

items.example: The volcano is extinct.

items.example: They extinguished the last embers.
items.exampleCN: 他们扑灭了最后的余烬。

items.example: An extinctive condition ended the licence.
items.exampleCN: 一条消灭条件终止了许可。

items.example: Two distinct calls mark the two species.
items.exampleCN: 两种不同的鸣声标记着两个物种。

items.example: Salmon return by instinct.
items.exampleCN: 鲑鱼靠本能洄游。

items.example: The extinguisher was empty.
items.exampleCN: 灭火器是空的。

definition_zh: 灭绝；消亡；（权利、债务的）消灭；（星光）消光
definition_en: the dying out of a species or the ending of something altogether
core_image: 一排灯原本一盏接一盏亮着，最后一盏也熄掉，整排陷入黑暗
scene: 这里指「灭绝」。 The extinction of the passenger pigeon became a warning for conservationists.
sceneCN: 这里 extinction 指「一个物种彻底消失」（第 1 个义项：某物种的最后个体死亡，种群不再延续）；句意为旅鸽的灭绝成了自然保护者的警钟。图中可辨识物件：空荡的树枝、褪色的鸟形轮廓、标本柜、记录的日期。

pos.zh: 灭绝；消亡；消灭（可数，复数 extinctions）

senses.title: A species dying out completely
senses.definition: the death of the last members of a species, so that it no longer exists
senses.definitionCN: 某物种最后个体死亡，从此不再存在
senses.example: The extinction of the passenger pigeon became a warning for conservationists.
senses.exampleCN: 旅鸽的灭绝成了自然保护者的警钟。
senses.why: extinction is the noun of extinguishing: a flame goes out and nothing of it is left, which is exactly the image used for a species.
senses.whyCN: extinction 是「熄灭」的名词：火苗灭掉后什么也不剩，物种灭绝用的正是这个意象。

senses.title: The process of dying out
senses.definition: the process by which the last members of a group decline and disappear
senses.definitionCN: 某类群最后的成员逐渐减少并消失的过程
senses.example: The extinction of the dodo unfolded over less than a century.
senses.exampleCN: 渡鸦的灭绝在不到一个世纪内展开。
senses.why: the noun names both the endpoint and the road to it, and the process reading is the one used in ecology.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词既指终点也指通往终点的路，生态学用的是过程这一读法。

senses.title: Local extinction, or extirpation
senses.titleCN: 局部灭绝：某地消失但别处尚有
senses.definition: the disappearance of a species from one region while it survives elsewhere
senses.definitionCN: 某物种在一个地区消失，但在别处仍然存在
senses.example: Wolves faced local extinction in the lowlands but held on in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 狼在低地遭遇局部灭绝，但在山区存续下来。
senses.why: because a species can vanish locally without vanishing globally, the noun takes a qualifier to mark the smaller scale.
senses.whyCN: 因为物种可以在本地消失而不在全球消失，这个名词需要限定语来标记较小的尺度。

senses.title: A mass extinction
senses.titleCN: 大灭绝：短时间内大量物种消失
senses.definition: an event in which a large share of all species disappears in a short span of geological time
senses.definitionCN: 在地质时间的短促跨度内，大比例物种消失的事件
senses.example: The end-Permian mass extinction removed most marine families.
senses.exampleCN: 二叠纪末大灭绝抹去了大多数海洋科。
senses.why: mass marks the scale, and extinction supplies the verb-derived idea of everything going out at once.
senses.whyCN: mass 标记规模，extinction 提供「一齐熄灭」的动词意象。

senses.title: A language or culture dying out
senses.definition: the disappearance of a language or way of life when its last speakers or practitioners die
senses.definitionCN: 语言或生活方式因最后使用者的离世而消失
senses.example: Linguists race to record languages facing extinction.
senses.exampleCN: 语言学家争相记录面临消亡的语言。
senses.why: the metaphor transfers the biological sense to anything whose carriers can die out, which is why languages are said to go extinct.
senses.whyCN: 这一隐喻把生物学含义移到任何「承载者会消亡」的事物上，因此语言也被说成灭绝。

senses.title: Dimming of starlight by dust
senses.titleCN: 天文学义：星际尘埃导致的星光消光
senses.definition: the absorption and scattering of starlight by interstellar matter
senses.definitionCN: 星际物质对星光的吸收与散射
senses.example: Interstellar dust causes the extinction of light from distant stars.
senses.exampleCN: 星际尘埃使远处恒星的光发生消光。
senses.why: astronomers borrowed the word because light is literally put out along the way, in the same sense as a flame.
senses.whyCN: 天文学家借用这个词，因为光确实在途中被「熄灭」，与火苗同理。

senses.title: A right or debt extinguished
senses.titleCN: 法律义：权利或债务的消灭
senses.definition: the ending of a legal right or obligation, as when a debt is paid off
senses.definitionCN: 某项法律权利或义务的终止，如债务清偿后消灭
senses.example: Payment produced the extinction of the debt.
senses.exampleCN: 付款使该债务归于消灭。
senses.why: law uses the word for anything that ceases to exist in the eyes of the law, keeping the core idea of being put out.
senses.whyCN: 法律用它指在法律眼中不复存在的事物，保留了「被熄灭」的核心。

senses.title: A conditioned response dying out
senses.titleCN: 行为心理学义：条件反应消退
senses.definition: the weakening and disappearance of a learned response when it is no longer reinforced
senses.definitionCN: 学习得来的反应因不再被强化而减弱并消失
senses.example: Extinction of the conditioned response followed repeated non-reinforcement.
senses.exampleCN: 在反复不予强化之后，条件反应出现了消退。
senses.why: psychology borrowed it for a response that fades away, treating the behaviour as the flame that goes out.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借它指逐渐消失的反应，把行为当作被熄灭的火。

intro.en: Extinction comes from Latin exstinctio, built on exstinguere 'to quench, put out', from ex- 'out' and stinguere 'to prick, quench'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: extinction 来自拉丁 exstinctio，基于 exstinguere「熄灭、扑灭」，由 ex-「向外」与 stinguere「刺、熄灭」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Stinguere meant 'to prick or quench'. its deeper origin is uncertain; a link to a root meaning 'to stick, prick' is a reconstruction rather than a demonstrated fact.
items.cn: stinguere 意为「刺、熄灭」。其更深来源不确定；把它连到表示「刺、扎」的词根只是重构，并非已证事实。

items.en: Ex- 'out' plus stinguere gave exstinguere 'to put out, quench, destroy', used of fires, lights and, figuratively, of families.
items.cn: ex-「向外」加 stinguere 得 exstinguere「扑灭、熄灭、毁掉」，用于火与光，也比喻家族断绝。

items.en: The noun exstinctio named a quenching or a putting out; English took it as extinction in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 名词 exstinctio 指熄灭或扑灭；英语于 15 世纪以 extinction 吸收。

items.en: The sense of a species dying out is recorded from the nineteenth century, as naturalists assembled the fossil record of vanished forms.
items.cn: 物种灭绝的意思在 19 世纪有记录，当时博物学家整理已消失类型的化石记录。

items.en: The twentieth century added the astronomical sense of light extinction and the psychological sense of response extinction.
items.cn: 20 世纪又增添了天文学的「消光」义与心理学的「反应消退」义。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates and deeper root): the exact first citation of the biological sense is not fixed, and the pre-Latin origin of stinguere remains unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：生物义的最早书证没有确定；stinguere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same stinguere stock that look alike; group two holds words for things ending, which differ in scope.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 stinguere 词干、形似的词；第二组表示「终结」，范围不同。

entries.definition: The state of having died out; extinction is the event or process that produces that state.
entries.definitionCN: 指已灭绝的状态；extinction 是造成该状态的事件或过程。

entries.definition: To put out a fire or light, or to wipe out a right; the noun extinction is its result.
entries.definitionCN: 扑灭火或光，或使权利消灭；名词 extinction 是其结果。

entries.definition: Dis- 'apart' plus stinguere: to mark things apart, hence to tell them apart. It has nothing to do with dying out.
entries.definitionCN: dis-「分开」加 stinguere：把事物区分开，因此指辨别。与灭绝无关。

entries.definition: In- 'in' plus stinguere, literally 'pricked on': an inborn drive. The same root, a very different path.
entries.definitionCN: in-「在内」加 stinguere，字面为「被内在刺动」：天生的驱力。同根而走向完全不同。

entries.definition: The removal of a species from one area while it survives elsewhere; extinction means the species is gone everywhere.
entries.definitionCN: 指某物种在一地被清除而别处仍存；extinction 指该物种处处不见。

entries.definition: A sharp local loss of many individuals; it need not end the species.
entries.definitionCN: 指一地大量个体骤然死亡；未必导致物种终结。

entries.definition: A broad word for removing something, from rivals to waste; it lacks the biological finality of extinction.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指去除，从对手到废物；不含 extinction 那种生物学上的终结性。

entries.definition: The fact of no longer being seen; a species may disappear from a survey and still return.
entries.definitionCN: 指不再被看见；物种可能从调查中消失却仍然回来。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ex- 'out' + stinguere 'quench': the flame is put right out.
normal.cn: ex-「向外」+ stinguere「熄灭」：火被彻底弄灭。

normal.en: The family runs extinction, extinct, extinguish, extinguisher, extinguishment.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 extinction、extinct、extinguish、extinguisher、extinguishment。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the scale: mass extinction, extinction event, brink of extinction.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出规模：大灭绝、灭绝事件、灭绝边缘。

normal.en: The same root shows in distinguish and instinct, both with different prefixes.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 distinguish 与 instinct 中，前缀都不同。

normal.en: Ecology counts local extinction separately from global extinction.
normal.cn: 生态学把局部灭绝与全球灭绝分开计数。

abstract.en: Picture the last candle in a row going out, and the room going dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一排蜡烛的最后一支熄灭，房间陷入黑暗。

abstract.en: Picture a language with one elderly speaker left, and then none.
abstract.cn: 想象一门语言只剩一位老人会说，然后一个也不剩。

abstract.en: Picture a star whose light is eaten by dust before it reaches a telescope.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗星的光在到达望远镜前被尘埃吃掉。

examples.en: Habitat loss is the leading cause of extinction today.
examples.cn: 生境丧失是当今灭绝的首要原因。

examples.en: The extinction rate is now far above the fossil background.
examples.cn: 当前的灭绝速率远高于化石记录的背景值。

examples.en: The debt's extinction must be recorded in the ledger.
examples.cn: 债务的消灭必须记入账簿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）+ tinct（熄灭）」——火苗彻底熄掉，什么也不剩 → 灭绝、消亡

root: 拉丁 exstinctio「熄灭」来自 exstinguere（ex-「向外」+ stinguere「刺、熄灭」）；stinguere 更深来源不确定，与 distinguish、instinct 同根不同前缀。英语 extinction。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one image: something is put out, and the putting-out is then read as a species, a process, a local loss, a mass event, a language, a beam of starlight, a legal right and a learned response.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个意象展开：某物被熄灭，这个「熄灭」再被读成物种、过程、局部丧失、大规模事件、语言、一束星光、法律权利与习得反应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the last flame of a row is put out and the row goes dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排火的最后一支被弄灭，整排陷入黑暗。

branches.en: SPECIES AND PROCESS: either the final state or the road that leads to it.
branches.cn: 物种与过程：或指终局状态，或指通向终局的路。

branches.en: SCALE MARKERS: a loss can be local, or vast enough to count as mass.
branches.cn: 尺度标记：丧失可以是局部的，也可以大到算作大灭绝。

branches.en: CARRIERS DIE OUT: languages and customs are treated as if they had last speakers.
branches.cn: 承载者消亡：语言与习俗被当作有「最后使用者」的事物。

branches.en: LIGHT PUT OUT: dust quenches starlight along the path.
branches.cn: 光被熄灭：尘埃在途中把星光弄灭。

branches.en: OTHER ENDINGS: rights and learned responses also cease to exist.
branches.cn: 其他终结：权利与习得反应同样不复存在。

intro.en: Extinction is a Latin noun of prefix plus root; ex- carries the sense of 'out', and the root also builds extinguish, distinguish and instinct.
intro.cn: extinction 是前缀加词根的拉丁名词；ex- 带「向外」的意思，同一词根还构成 extinguish、distinguish 与 instinct。

latinIntro.en: Latin exstinguere gives extinction, extinct and extinguish; dis- and in- versions of the same root give distinguish and instinct.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 exstinguere 衍生 extinction、extinct 与 extinguish；同一词根的 dis- 与 in- 版本给出 distinguish 与 instinct。

items.example: The prefix marks the flame being driven out.
items.exampleCN: 前缀标记火被赶出去。

items.example: The root supplies the quenching image.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供「熄灭」的意象。

items.example: Mass extinction removed most marine families.
items.exampleCN: 大灭绝抹去了大多数海洋科。

items.example: The volcano is extinct.
items.exampleCN: 这座火山已经熄灭。

items.example: Crews extinguished the fire within an hour.
items.exampleCN: 消防队在小时内扑灭了火。

items.meaning: a device for putting out fires
items.example: The extinguisher sits by the door.
items.exampleCN: 灭火器放在门边。

items.meaning: to mark apart; to tell apart
items.example: The stripes distinguish the two species.
items.exampleCN: 条纹把这两个物种区分开。

items.example: The bird finds the route by instinct.
items.exampleCN: 这种鸟靠本能找到路线。

items.meaning: tending to put out or end
items.example: The extinctive clause ended the easement.
items.exampleCN: 那条消灭条款终止了地役权。

definition_zh: 熄灭；扑灭；消除；使消灭；解除（债务、权利）
definition_en: to put out a fire or a light, or to bring something such as hope, a debt, or a right to a complete end
core_image: 一桶水浇在火堆上，最后一点火星也被压灭
scene: 一阵急雨把篝火浇灭，只剩下一圈湿透的灰。A sudden shower extinguished the campfire and left only a ring of wet ash.
sceneCN: 这里 extinguish 是「熄灭」（第 1 个义项：把火或灯弄灭）；句意：一阵急雨把篝火浇灭，只留下一圈湿透的灰。

pos.zh: 熄灭；扑灭；消除；使消灭；解除（债务、权利）

由拉丁语词干加 -ion 构成，义为「灭绝；熄灭」
加否定前缀与 -able 构成，义为「无法扑灭的」

senses.title: To put out a flame or a light
senses.definition: to make a candle, a lamp, or a small fire stop burning
senses.definitionCN: 使蜡烛、灯或小火停止燃烧
senses.example: She extinguished the candle with a small brass cap.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一只小铜盖把蜡烛熄灭了。
senses.why: The Latin verb names the act of putting a flame out, so a small light going dark is the plainest sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁语动词本指把火焰弄灭，所以一盏小灯暗下来就是它最朴素的一层。

senses.title: To put out a large fire
senses.definition: to stop a blaze or a burning building from burning further, by water, foam, or other means
senses.definitionCN: 用水、泡沫等手段使大火或着火的建筑停止燃烧
senses.example: Crews extinguished the blaze before it reached the barn.
senses.exampleCN: 消防队在火势蔓延到谷仓之前把大火扑灭了。
senses.why: The same act is scaled up from a wick to a warehouse, and the word keeps the same quiet certainty of an ending.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动作从烛芯放大到仓库，词里那份「彻底结束」的笃定没有变。

senses.title: To end a feeling or a hope
senses.definition: to destroy a feeling, a hope, or a memory completely
senses.definitionCN: 彻底毁掉某种情感、希望或记忆
senses.example: Nothing could extinguish her belief that he would return.
senses.exampleCN: 什么也无法消除她对他会回来的信念。
senses.why: A hope burns like a small flame, so putting it out becomes the standard image for killing it.
senses.whyCN: 希望像一簇小火苗那样燃烧，把火弄灭于是成了「扼杀希望」的标准意象。

senses.title: To destroy a life or a group
senses.definition: to kill a person or wipe out a whole group, used of severe and often impersonal destruction
senses.definitionCN: 杀死某人或使整个群体灭绝，多用于严酷而无情的毁灭
senses.example: The fever extinguished entire villages along the river.
senses.exampleCN: 那场热病使沿河的整座整座村庄消失。
senses.why: When a life is compared to a flame, killing becomes putting it out, and the verb turns cold and total.
senses.whyCN: 把生命比作火焰，杀戮就成了「把火弄灭」，这个词于是变得冷酷而彻底。

senses.title: To wipe out a debt or a duty
senses.definition: to settle a debt or a duty so that nothing remains owed
senses.definitionCN: 把债务或义务结清，使不再有任何亏欠
senses.example: One final payment extinguished the whole loan.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一笔付款使整笔贷款彻底清偿。
senses.why: In law a debt is treated as a live obligation, so ending it completely is described as putting it out.
senses.whyCN: 在法律上债务被当作一份仍活着的义务，彻底终结它就被说成「弄灭」。

senses.title: To cancel a right at law
senses.definition: to bring a right, a claim, or an interest to an end by a legal act or by the passage of time
senses.definitionCN: 通过法律行为或时间经过使权利、请求权或权益终结
senses.example: The easement was extinguished when the two plots were merged.
senses.exampleCN: 两块地合并之后，那项地役权就消灭了。
senses.why: Legal language borrows the fire image for anything that must stop existing altogether, including an abstract right.
senses.whyCN: 法律语言借用了那幅火的画面，用来指任何必须彻底不复存在的东西，包括抽象的权利。

senses.title: To silence opposition
senses.definition: to suppress dissent, criticism, or a rival so that it can no longer be heard
senses.definitionCN: 压制异议、批评或对手，使其再也发不出声音
senses.example: The new rules were meant to extinguish any open criticism.
senses.exampleCN: 新规定的用意是压制一切公开的批评。
senses.why: A voice, like a flame, can be snuffed out, and the verb lends the act an air of total and silent removal.
senses.whyCN: 声音和火焰一样可以被掐灭，这个词给这种行为添上「彻底而无声地清除」的意味。

senses.title: To quench thirst
senses.definition: to satisfy thirst, in older or literary writing
senses.definitionCN: 解渴，用于较古旧或书面的文字
senses.example: A single cup of water extinguished his thirst.
senses.exampleCN: 一杯水就解了他的渴。
senses.why: Thirst was once pictured as a burning inside the body, so cooling it off was the same act of putting a fire out.
senses.whyCN: 口渴曾被想象成体内有火在烧，把它凉下来正是同一个「灭火」的动作。

intro.en: Extinguish comes from Latin exstinguere, to put out or destroy, built from ex-, out, and stinguere, whose earliest image is commonly given as to prick.
intro.cn: extinguish 来自拉丁语 exstinguere，意为弄灭、消灭，由 ex-（向外）与 stinguere 构成，后者最早的意象一般释为「刺、扎」。

items.en: Stinguere is usually glossed as to prick or goad; the exact original picture is not certain.
items.cn: stinguere 一般释为「刺、扎」，其确切的最初意象并不完全确定。

items.en: The prefix ex- adds the sense of out or utterly.
items.cn: 前缀 ex- 添上「向外、彻底」的意思。

items.en: Exstinguere means to put out a fire, to quench, and to destroy.
items.cn: exstinguere 意为把火弄灭、熄灭、消灭。

items.en: Esteindre carries the verb into French with the same fire sense.
items.cn: esteindre 把这个动词带入法语，「火」的含义原样保留。

items.en: English takes extinguish from the French form in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪从法语形式借入 extinguish。

items.en: Law and ecology give the verb new objects: debts, rights, and whole species.
items.cn: 法律与生态学给这个动词添了新对象：债务、权利与整个物种。

note.en: Extinguish belongs to the stinguere family with extinct, extinction, and distinguish, and sits beside quench, douse, and suppress.
note.cn: extinguish 属于 stinguere 词族，与 extinct、extinction、distinguish 同根，也与 quench、douse、suppress 意义相邻。

entries.definition: a device or person that puts out fires
entries.definitionCN: 灭火器；灭火的人，由 extinguish 加 -er 构成

entries.definition: no longer existing, as a species or a volcano
entries.definitionCN: 已灭绝的；已熄灭的，与 extinguish 同出拉丁语词干

entries.definition: to tell one thing apart from another
entries.definitionCN: 区分；辨别，同出 stinguere 词根，但前缀与意义都不同

entries.definition: to put out a fire or satisfy thirst
entries.definitionCN: 扑灭（火）；解（渴），与 extinguish 的义域高度重合

entries.definition: to pour water over something, especially to put out a fire
to stop something by force, such as a revolt or a feeling
entries.definitionCN: 镇压；抑制，多用于抽象对象

normalIntro.en: Extinguish is ex- plus stinguere, an old verb for pricking: the flame is struck out, and anything that must end completely follows the same picture.
normalIntro.cn: extinguish 是 ex- 加 stinguere，后者是表示「刺」的古动词：火被刺灭，凡是必须彻底结束的东西都沿用这幅画面。

normal.en: Ex- plus stinguere gives the idea of striking a flame out.
normal.cn: ex- 加 stinguere，给出「把火刺灭」这一意象。

normal.en: Firefighters extinguish a blaze with water, foam, or sand.
normal.cn: 消防员用水、泡沫或沙子扑灭大火。

normal.en: A debt is extinguished by one final payment.
normal.cn: 一笔债务靠最后一次付款得以清偿。

normal.en: Extinguish and extinguisher differ by one ending: the shorter one is the act, the longer one the tool.
normal.cn: extinguish 与 extinguisher 只差一个词尾：短的是动作，长的是工具。

normal.en: Compare extinguish with quench: quench suits thirst and flames, while extinguish is broader and more formal.
normal.cn: 对比 quench：quench 适用于口渴与火焰，extinguish 范围更广、也更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a wet finger pinching a candle wick until the glow dies.
abstract.cn: 想象用湿手指捏住烛芯，直到那点光灭掉。

abstract.en: Imagine a wall of foam rolling over a burning shed.
abstract.cn: 想象一堵泡沫墙滚过着火的小屋，把火整个盖住。

abstract.en: Think of a lamp switched off in a room where someone meant to read all night.
abstract.cn: 想象有人本想读一整夜，屋里的灯却被关掉了。

examples.en: The firefighters extinguished the blaze before it reached the neighbouring barn.
examples.cn: 消防员在火势蔓延到邻近谷仓之前把大火扑灭了。

examples.en: Nothing could extinguish her belief that the missing climber would come home.
examples.cn: 什么也无法消除她那份信念：失踪的登山者会回家。

examples.en: A single payment would extinguish the whole debt under the settlement.
examples.cn: 按照这份和解协议，一笔付款就能使整笔债务清偿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊克斯汀格维什」——谐音近似「一泼水，星火灭」：水一泼，火星就灭，所以是「熄灭」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外、彻底）+ stinguere（刺、扎）→ exstinguere（把火刺灭、扑灭、消灭）→ 古法语 esteindre → 英语 extinguish，核心义「把火彻底弄灭」。

sensesIntro.en: Extinguish moves from a candle wick to a burning building, then to hope and to life itself, and finally to debts, rights, dissent, and thirst, always keeping the image of a flame that is put out for good.
sensesIntro.cn: extinguish 从烛芯走到着火的建筑，再走到希望与生命本身，最后落到债务、权利、异议与口渴，始终保留「火被彻底弄灭」那幅画面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water falling on a fire until the last spark goes dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：水浇在火上，直到最后一点火星暗下去。

branches.en: Snuffing a candle is the core physical sense.
branches.cn: 掐灭一根蜡烛，是最核心的物理义项。

branches.en: Fighting a blaze is the same act at the scale of a building.
branches.cn: 扑救大火，是同一动作放大到建筑的规模。

branches.en: Hope and fear end like a flame going out, which is the figurative sense.
branches.cn: 希望与恐惧像火焰熄灭那样结束，这是比喻义项。

branches.en: Destroying people and silencing dissent both aim at making a force vanish.
branches.cn: 消灭人与压制异议，都是要让一股力量彻底消失。

branches.en: A debt, a right, and thirst are all ended as if a fire had been put out.
branches.cn: 债务、权利与口渴都被当作一团火那样被弄灭。

intro.en: Extinguish comes from Latin ex- and stinguere, and English has built extinguisher, extinct, and extinction on the same root.
intro.cn: extinguish 由拉丁语前缀 ex- 与 stinguere 构成，英语又在同一词根上造出 extinguisher、extinct 与 extinction。

latinIntro.en: Latin stinguere is usually glossed as to prick or quench, and exstinguere as to put out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stinguere 一般释为「刺、扎」，exstinguere 意为「刺灭、扑灭」。

items.example: The prefix ex- pushes the action through to the end.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 把动作推到彻底完成。

items.example: Stinguere supplies the striking image behind the word.
items.exampleCN: stinguere 提供了这个词背后「刺一下」的意象。

items.example: Exstinguere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: exstinguere 把前缀与词根合在一起。

items.meaning: to put out a fire or end something completely
items.example: Extinguish keeps the Latin verb almost whole.
items.exampleCN: extinguish 几乎原样保留了那个拉丁语动词。

items.example: The suffix -er forms the name of the tool.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 构成了工具的名称。

items.meaning: a device for putting out fires
items.example: Extinguisher is the device, not the act.
items.exampleCN: extinguisher 指器具，不指动作。

items.example: Extinct is the finished state of being extinguished.
items.exampleCN: extinct 是「已被弄灭」之后的状态。

items.meaning: the ending of a species or a flame
items.example: Extinction names the ending itself.
items.exampleCN: extinction 指「结束」这件事本身。

items.example: Inextinguishable adds a negative prefix and -able.
items.exampleCN: inextinguishable 加上否定前缀与 -able。

items.example: Distinguish shares stinguere but takes a different prefix.
items.exampleCN: distinguish 共享 stinguere，却换了另一个前缀。

senses.title: A portable fire-fighting cylinder
senses.definition: a metal cylinder filled with foam, powder, or gas that is carried by hand and used to put out a small fire
senses.definitionCN: 装满泡沫、干粉或气体、可用手提到现场扑灭小火的金属圆筒
senses.example: She grabbed the extinguisher and sprayed the base of the flames.
senses.exampleCN: 她抓起灭火器，对着火焰的根部喷射。
senses.why: Latin ex- means out and stinguere means to quench, so an extinguisher is literally the thing that quenches a fire out.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ex- 表示「出」，stinguere 表示「熄灭、扑灭」，所以这个器具就是「把火弄灭的东西」；手提圆筒是最典型的一种。

senses.title: A fixed automatic suppression system
senses.titleCN: 固定式灭火装置；自动灭火系统
senses.definition: a built-in apparatus in a building, vehicle, or engine that releases a fire-killing substance automatically
senses.definitionCN: 安装在建筑、车辆或发动机内、能自动喷出灭火物质的固定装置
senses.example: The kitchen ceiling has an automatic extinguisher above the stove.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房天花板上有一只位于灶台上方的自动灭火装置。
senses.why: The suffix -er names any thing that performs the action, so a fixed automatic system is an extinguisher too, not only a hand-held cylinder.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -er 指「做这件事的东西」，所以固定在头顶、自动喷放的装置同样叫 extinguisher，并不限于手提圆筒。

senses.title: A person who puts out a fire
senses.definition: a person who extinguishes a fire or a light, used mainly in older or literary writing
senses.definitionCN: 把火或灯弄灭的人，主要用于较旧的文字或书面语
senses.example: An extinguisher in those days was a man with a bucket, not a machine.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个年代，灭火器指的是提着水桶的人，而不是机器。
senses.why: Before machines took the name, -er simply meant the person who does the action, so extinguisher first named a firefighter with a bucket.
senses.whyCN: 在机器占用这个名字之前，-er 只表示「做这件事的人」，所以 extinguisher 最初指提着水桶灭火的人。

senses.title: A small cone for snuffing candles
senses.definition: a small metal cone on a handle that is placed over a candle flame to put it out
senses.definitionCN: 带柄的小金属锥罩，罩在烛火上使其熄灭
senses.example: She put the brass extinguisher over the candle and the room went dark.
senses.exampleCN: 她把黄铜熄烛罩罩在蜡烛上，房间暗了下来。
senses.why: The same -er pattern applies to a table tool that quenches a candle, and the name has stayed in use for this small household object.
senses.whyCN: 同一条 -er 构词方式也用在餐桌上熄灭蜡烛的小器具上，这个名字一直沿用至今，专指这件家常小物。

intro.en: Extinguisher is built from the Latin prefix ex-, out, and stinguere, to quench, through exstinguere, to put out a fire.
intro.cn: extinguisher 由拉丁语前缀 ex-（出）与 stinguere（熄灭、扑灭）构成，经由 exstinguere（把火弄灭）进入英语。

items.en: Stinguere means to quench or to put out, and it carries the image of pricking a light out.
items.cn: stinguere 意为熄灭、扑灭，带有「把光点戳灭」的意象。

items.en: Exstinguere adds ex- and means to put out a fire, a lamp, or a life.
items.cn: exstinguere 加上 ex-，意为弄灭火、灯乃至生命。

items.en: Its past participle exstinctus later gives the English word extinct.
items.cn: 它的过去分词 exstinctus 后来给出英语的 extinct。

items.en: Old French esteindre passes the verb into English as extinguish.
items.cn: 古法语 esteindre 把这个动词传进英语，成为 extinguish。

items.en: An extinguisher first means a person who puts out a fire.
items.cn: extinguisher 最初指把火弄灭的人。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the word names the portable cylinder that hangs on a wall today.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，这个词开始指今天挂在墙上的手提圆筒。

note.en: Extinguisher shares its root with extinguish and extinction, and it sits in the vocabulary of firefighting equipment.
note.cn: extinguisher 与 extinguish、extinction 同根，属于消防器材这一词语场。

entries.definitionCN: 灭绝的；死火的（同根，来自拉丁语分词）

a pipe in the street that firefighters connect a hose to

normalIntro.en: Extinguisher is a quench word: stinguere means to put out, and -er names whatever does the quenching.
normalIntro.cn: extinguisher 是一个关于「熄灭」的词：stinguere 意为弄灭，-er 指做这件事的人或物。

normal.en: Extinguisher is ex- plus stinguere, to quench, with -er naming the tool.
normal.cn: extinguisher 是 ex- 加 stinguere（熄灭），再由 -er 点明「做这件事的器具」。

normal.en: A fire extinguisher is checked once a year and refilled after use.
normal.cn: 灭火器每年检查一次，用过后要重新充装。

normal.en: Foam, dry powder, and carbon dioxide are the common types of extinguisher.
normal.cn: 泡沫、干粉与二氧化碳是常见的灭火器类型。

normal.en: Older texts use extinguisher for the person who puts the fire out.
normal.cn: 较旧的文字用 extinguisher 指把火弄灭的人。

normal.en: Compare extinguisher with the verb extinguish: the noun names the tool, the verb names the act.
normal.cn: 对比动词 extinguish：名词指器具，动词指动作。

abstract.en: Picture a red cylinder in a glass case, its pin pulled in one movement.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃柜里一只红色圆筒，一个动作就把保险销拔下。

abstract.en: Picture a nozzle above a stove waking up on its own as smoke rises.
abstract.cn: 想象灶台上方的喷嘴在烟雾升起时自己醒过来。

abstract.en: Picture a man with a bucket standing between a fire and a wooden house.
abstract.cn: 想象一个提着水桶的人站在火与木屋之间。

examples.en: Every floor of the hotel has a fire extinguisher beside the lift.
examples.cn: 酒店每一层的电梯旁都有一只灭火器。

examples.en: The extinguisher failed because nobody had checked the pressure gauge for years.
examples.cn: 这只灭火器失效了，因为多年没人检查压力表。

examples.en: He kept a small extinguisher in the boot of the car for camping trips.
examples.cn: 他在汽车后备箱里放了一只小灭火器，供露营时使用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一克斯丁规舍」——谐音近似「一喷熄火」，一喷就把火弄熄，正是灭火器；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（出）+ stinguere（熄灭）→ exstinguere（弄灭）→ 古法语 esteindre → 英语 extinguish → extinguisher（灭火之物、灭火之人），核心义是「把火彻底弄灭」。

sensesIntro.en: Extinguisher names first the person who quenches a fire, then the hand-held cylinder, and also the fixed automatic system and the small cone that snuffs a candle.
sensesIntro.cn: extinguisher 先指灭火的人，再指手提圆筒，也指固定的自动装置与罩灭蜡烛的小锥罩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pressing a cone or a nozzle down on a flame until the light goes out.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把锥罩或喷嘴按在火上，直到光熄灭。

branches.en: The hand-held cylinder is the sense every learner meets first.
branches.cn: 手提圆筒是学习者最先遇到的义项。

branches.en: A fixed system does the same quenching without a human hand.
branches.cn: 固定装置不用人手，也完成同样的「熄灭」动作。

branches.en: The agent sense keeps the old meaning of a person who fights fire.
branches.cn: 施事义项保留了「灭火的人」这一古老含义。

branches.en: The candle cone is the smallest object to carry the name.
branches.cn: 熄烛锥罩是承载这个名字的最小物件。

branches.en: A big cylinder and a small cone are both tools that press a fire out.
branches.cn: 大圆筒与小锥罩都是把火按灭的器具。

intro.en: Extinguisher grows from the Latin verb stinguere, to quench, through exstinguere, and the English suffix -er adds the idea of a person or a tool.
intro.cn: extinguisher 由拉丁语动词 stinguere（熄灭）经 exstinguere 演变而来，英语词尾 -er 再加上「人或器具」的意思。

latinIntro.en: Latin stinguere means to quench or to put out, and exstinguere means to extinguish a fire or a life.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stinguere 意为熄灭、扑灭，exstinguere 意为把火或生命弄灭。

items.example: The prefix ex- gives the sense of putting something out.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ex- 带来「使某物灭掉、出来」的意思。

items.example: Stinguere is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: stinguere 是整个词族的词根。

definition_zh: 颂扬；赞颂；高度赞扬；吹捧
definition_en: to praise a person or a thing very highly, especially in public or in writing
core_image: 人群把冠军扛在肩上，高高举过头顶
scene: 毕业典礼上，班主任用了很长时间称赞那位照顾同学一整年的学生。At the graduation ceremony, the head teacher extolled the student who had looked after his classmates all year.
sceneCN: 这里 extol 是「高度赞扬」（第 1 个义项：公开地极力称赞某人）；句意：毕业典礼上，班主任盛赞那位一年来默默照顾同学的学生。

pos.zh: 颂扬；赞颂；高度赞扬；吹捧

derivatives.zh: 由 extol 加名词词尾 -ment 构成，义为「颂扬；赞美」，使用较少
由 extol 加施事词尾 -er 构成，义为「颂扬者；赞美者」

senses.title: To praise a person highly
senses.definition: to speak of a person with great praise, especially in front of other people
senses.definitionCN: 在众人面前极力称赞某人
senses.example: The coach extolled the young goalkeeper after the final whistle.
senses.exampleCN: 终场哨响后，教练对年轻门将大加赞扬。
senses.why: Latin ex- means out and tollere means to lift, so extollere is to lift someone up before others, and praise is that lifting done with words.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ex- 表示「出」，tollere 表示「举起」，extollere 就是把人举到众人面前，用言语赞美正是这种「举起」。

senses.title: To praise the merits of a thing
senses.definition: to praise the good qualities of an object, a plan, or an idea strongly
senses.definitionCN: 极力称赞某样东西、某个计划或某种想法的优点
senses.example: The brochure extols the benefits of cycling to work.
senses.exampleCN: 这本宣传册称颂骑车上班的好处。
senses.why: The lifted image moves easily from a person to a thing, and the common pattern extol the virtues of keeps this sense alive.
senses.whyCN: 「举起」的画面很容易从人转到物，常用搭配「extol the virtues of」让这个义项一直活跃。

senses.title: To glorify a quality or a deed
senses.definition: to praise a quality, an achievement, or a value in a formal or ceremonial way
senses.definitionCN: 以正式或仪式化的方式颂扬某种品质、成就或价值
senses.example: The speech extolled the courage of the volunteers.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇演讲颂扬了志愿者们的勇气。
senses.why: Words that lift a person can also lift an abstract quality, and public speeches are where that ceremonial praise is heard.
senses.whyCN: 能把人举起来的词，也能把抽象的品质举起来，公共演讲正是这种仪式化赞美的场合。

senses.title: To praise God
senses.definition: to praise God or a deity, used in religious language
senses.definitionCN: 赞美上帝或神明，用于宗教语言
senses.example: The psalm extols the mercy of the Lord.
senses.exampleCN: 这首赞美诗颂扬主的仁慈。
senses.why: The Latin verb was used for lifting up the divine in worship, so the religious sense is one of the oldest layers of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁语动词早在礼拜中就用于「高举神明」，宗教义项是这个词最古老的层次之一。

senses.title: To overpraise for advantage
senses.definition: to praise someone more than they deserve, especially in order to win favour
senses.definitionCN: 过分地称赞某人，尤指为了讨好对方
senses.example: Some columnists extol every new gadget because the makers pay them.
senses.exampleCN: 有些专栏作家吹捧每一款新玩意儿，因为厂商付钱给他们。
senses.why: When lifting with words is done for gain, the same verb slides into flattery, which shows how close praise and self-interest can be.
senses.whyCN: 当「用语言举起」是为了利益，这个词就滑向奉承，可见赞美与私利常常只隔一步。

intro.en: Extol comes from Latin ex-, out and up, and tollere, to lift, through extollere, to lift up and therefore to praise.
intro.cn: extol 来自拉丁语 ex-（向外、向上）与 tollere（举起），经由 extollere（举起，因而赞美）进入英语。

items.en: Tollere means to lift, to raise, and also to carry something off.
items.cn: tollere 意为举起、抬起，也有「搬走」的意思。

items.en: Extollere adds ex- and means to lift something up high.
items.cn: extollere 加上 ex-，意为把某物高高举起。

items.en: Cicero and other writers use extollere for lifting a person up in praise.
items.cn: 西塞罗等作家用 extollere 表示把某人举进赞美之中。

items.en: Old French extoller keeps the sense of praising aloud.
items.cn: 古法语 extoller 保留了「高声赞美」的意思。

items.en: English extol appears in the fifteenth century as a formal word for praise.
items.cn: 英语 extol 在十五世纪出现，是正式的「赞美」用词。

items.en: Today it survives mainly in written English and in the pattern extol the virtues of.
items.cn: 今天它主要活在书面英语与「extol the virtues of」这一搭配里。

note.en: Extol shares its root with the Latin tollere and is easily confused with exalt, extort, and exhort.
note.cn: extol 与拉丁语 tollere 同根，又容易与 exalt、extort、exhort 混淆。

normalIntro.en: Extol is a lifting word: ex- pushes up, tollere raises, and praise is the lift that speech gives.
normalIntro.cn: extol 是一个关于「举起」的词：ex- 向上推，tollere 抬起，赞美就是言语完成的那次举起。

normal.en: Extol is ex- plus tollere, to lift: praise lifts a person up in words.
normal.cn: extol 是 ex- 加 tollere（举起）：赞美就是用言语把人举起来。

normal.en: Writers extol the virtues of a plan when they want others to adopt it.
normal.cn: 写作者称颂一个计划的好处，是想让别人采纳它。

normal.en: The verb is formal, so it suits speeches, reviews, and ceremonies.
normal.cn: 这个动词偏正式，适合演讲、评论与典礼。

normal.en: Extol takes a direct object: you extol a person, a book, or a virtue.
normal.cn: extol 直接带宾语：可以颂扬一个人、一本书或一种美德。

normal.en: Compare extol with praise: praise is the everyday word, while extol is stronger and more public.
normal.cn: 对比 praise：praise 是日常词，extol 语气更强、更公开。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd carrying a champion on their shoulders through the street.
abstract.cn: 想象人群把冠军扛在肩上走过街道。

abstract.en: Picture a hand lifting a new machine high so that everyone can see it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把一台新机器高高举起，让所有人都看见。

abstract.en: Picture a banner raised over a stage while a long speech rolls on.
abstract.cn: 想象演讲进行时，一面横幅在舞台上方升起。

examples.en: Reviewers extolled the film for its quiet attention to ordinary lives.
examples.cn: 影评人盛赞这部影片对普通人生活的安静关注。

examples.en: The retired general was extolled as the saviour of the city.
examples.cn: 这位退役将军被赞为城市的救星。

examples.en: Advertisements extol the virtues of a cream that few skin doctors recommend.
examples.cn: 广告大肆称颂一款很少有皮肤科医生推荐的乳霜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一克斯托」——谐音近似「一夸就托」，把人夸得托到天上，正是「颂扬」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外、向上）+ tollere（举起）→ extollere（高举；颂扬）→ 古法语 extoller → 英语 extol，核心义是「把人或物高举起来称赞」。

sensesIntro.en: Extol starts as the act of lifting a person up in words, then lifts the merits of things and abstract qualities, and finally shades into flattery.
sensesIntro.cn: extol 起于「用言语把人举起」，随后举起的是事物的优点与抽象的品质，最后带上一点吹捧的色彩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crowd lifting a hero above their heads while cheering.
core.cn: 核心意象：人群一边欢呼，一边把英雄高高举过头顶。

branches.en: Lifting a person in front of others is the core sense of the verb.
branches.cn: 在众人面前把人举起来，是这个动词的核心义项。

branches.en: The lifted object becomes a thing whose merits are praised.
branches.cn: 被举起的东西变成一件优点受到称颂的物件。

branches.en: Abstract qualities are lifted in speeches and ceremonies.
branches.cn: 抽象的品质在演讲与典礼中被举高。

branches.en: Religious language lifts the divine in worship.
branches.cn: 宗教语言在礼拜中把神明高举。

branches.en: Praise offered for gain turns the same lift into flattery.
branches.cn: 为了利益而献上的赞美，把同一次「举起」变成了吹捧。

intro.en: Extol is the Latin prefix ex- plus tollere, to lift, and English has kept the verb mostly in formal writing.
intro.cn: extol 是拉丁语前缀 ex- 加 tollere（举起）而成，英语把这个动词主要保留在正式书面语里。

latinIntro.en: Latin tollere means to lift or to raise, and extollere means to lift up and so to praise.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tollere 意为举起、抬起，extollere 意为高举，因而表示赞美。
